Hi

I want to visualize data using shiny, R and d3.js.  A sample code for the visualization is attached here.

For the visualization a user can upload a data file and that datafile contains two column matrix of coordinates that coordinates are being plotted on the browser using d3.js API.

For each datapoint a mouseclick event produces  a new visualization. Which is generated in R by using 'Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler'  in the 'mouseclick' function and then be executed in R and sends data back to the
javascript.  'session$sendCustomMessage' sends data back to R.

This all works fine to me but when I upload second data file  without refreshing the page, the 'mouseclick' function does not respond whenever I click to any data point. And the 'observe' function in shiny remains active, and retains old data from the previous session.
 Also sends response to the Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler while uploading the file.

So I am not able to visualize data second time by uploading a different file without refreshing the page.

I tried hard to solve the problem but couldn't find any solution.
I also want to know that is it possible to flush or delete the existing session in shiny whenever I upload a new file.

I attach these sample code files along with the data file test.csv

The sample codes are as follow.

Thanks in advance.

Best,
S

library(shiny)                            
reactiveData <- function (outputId)       
{                                         
  HTML(paste("<div id=\"", outputId, "\" class=\"shiny-data-output\"><svg /></div>", sep=""))
}                                         
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(                  
        headerPanel("dataV"),             
        sidebarPanel(                          
                uiOutput("layoutControls" ),   
                uiOutput("plotControls" ) ,                    
                fileInput("file1", "Choose CSV File",  multiple=FALSE,accept=c('csv') ),
                verbatimTextOutput("tres")                 
        ),                                     
        mainPanel(                         
                               
                tabsetPanel(   
                        tabPanel("Plot", includeHTML("graph.js"),includeHTML("color.js"),
                                        reactiveData(outputId = "mainnet")
                                       
                        )
                )      
        )                      
                       
))                     
######## Server.R ########
library(shiny)                            
                                          
reactivedataMatrix <- function(func){     
  reactive(function(){                    
        val <- func()                     
        zz <- NULL

                zz <- list(names=-1, colx=-1, id = -1, cx=-1, cy=-1, vwt=-1)
        }                                      
        else{                                                  
                zz <- list(names=1:nrow(val), colx=rep("#FF0000",nrow(val)), id = c(0:(nrow(val)-1)), cx=val[,1], cy=val[,2], vwt=rep(8,nrow(val)))
                                                           
        }                                      
        zz                                 
 })                            
                               
}                      
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
                       
         g <- reactive({       
                flag=FALSE
                info <- input$file1
                  if(!is.null(info)){
                        dataset<- try(read.table(info$datapath, sep="\t", header=T), silent=T)
                }
        })

         output$mainnet <- reactivedataMatrix(function() {
                                        pp <- (g())
                                        print(pp)
                                        pp
         })

output$tres <- renderPrint({
nb <- NULL
el <- NULL
observe({
nb <- sample(as.numeric(input$mydata$dist))
print(nb)
session$onFlushed(once=TRUE, function() {
x <- session$sendCustomMessage(type='testmessage', list(value=nb))
})
})
nb
})

})
